summary: F2 confirms an OWA inbox forwarding rule to r.yavuz.ozel@gmail.com, indicating potential email exfiltration for r.yavuz@aegean.edu. The claimed bulk SIS access from 198.51.100.44 was rejected after an independent recount found 123 events versus 25 claimed, exceeding tolerance. Risk Gate overrides the model's contain recommendation and sets escalate due to a partial abuse chain and insufficient confirmed access signals despite the confirmed compromise indicator.

actions.action: Delete the forwarding rule to r.yavuz.ozel@gmail.com and audit all OWA/Exchange inbox rules for the account.
Force password reset, revoke active sessions and OAuth grants, and enforce MFA for r.yavuz@aegean.edu.
Review mailbox audit logs and sent/deleted items for additional external forwarding or exfiltration activity.
Monitor and preserve SIS authentication logs and connections from 198.51.100.44 for recurrence during escalation.

The rejected bulk-SIS claim adds no confirmed compromise and is resolved by data-quality conflict. One confirmed ATO indicator is sufficient to warrant containment.
